items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stan Kenton one time, Duke Ellington another time.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about Duke as a pianist.

Yeah. Because of my dad – in Chicago, when I was a kid, the major movie houses also had stage shows. It was towards the end of the big-band era. At the Chicago Theater, State-Lake Theatre, Oriental Theatre, the Garrick Theatre – mainly Chicago Theater, after the movie, Stan Kenton one time, Duke Ellington another time. Dad was into the big-band stuff. Then I got to meet Duke – I think we were in Tokyo when I met Duke Ellington. We were outside the hotel – and was very impressed with him as a person. You’ve heard…
Was he familiar with you and your work?
